title: Breakfast at Home
text:
Every morning my family eats breakfast together in the kitchen. We have eggs, bread and cheese. My father makes tea for everyone. After breakfast, I brush my teeth and go to school.

On Sundays we eat a special meal. My mother cooks rice and chicken. My grandfather likes soup before the main meal. We sit at the table for a long time and talk about our week.

questions.text: What does the father make every morning?
What does the mother cook on Sundays?
How does the family probably feel about Sunday meals?
options: They think the meals are boring
They are often in a hurry

questions.text: Why does the writer go to school after breakfast?
options: Because school is a daily routine

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a room where food is cooked
a piece of furniture where people sit to eat

paragraph_translations: Her sabah ailem mutfakta birlikte kahvaltı yapar. Yumurta, ekmek ve peynirimiz olur. Babam herkes için çay hazırlar. Kahvaltıdan sonra dişlerimi fırçalar ve okula giderim.
Pazar günleri özel bir yemek yeriz. Annem pirinç pilavı ve tavuk pişirir. Dedem ana yemekten önce çorba sever. Masada uzun süre oturur ve haftamızı konuşuruz.
